'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] kills six civilians in [[Toretsk]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], as [[Ukraine]] says that Russia appears to be preparing for a new ground offensive near [[Sloviansk]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-62207922 (BBC News)]
** [[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast]]
*** Russia announces {{ill|Anton Koltsov|ru|Кольцов, Антон Викторович}}, former Prime Minister of [[Vologda Oblast]], as the new Prime Minister in Zaporizhzhia Military-Civilian Administration. His appointment probably took place some days earlier.<ref>[https://euromaidanpress.com/2022/07/19/russia-appoints-ex-first-deputy-of-vologda-region-anton-koltsov-as-sham-council-head-of-zaporizhzhia-oblast/ (Euromaidan Press)]</ref>

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Russia in the European energy sector]]
**[[Russia]]'s [[Gazprom]] says that it "cannot guarantee" gas supplies to [[Europe]] due to "extraordinary circumstances" as it declares [[force majeure]] on gas supplies dating from June 14. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/russias-gazprom-declares-force-majeure-gas-supplies-europe-2022-07-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 European heat waves]]
**[[2022 United Kingdom heat wave]]
***The [[United Kingdom]] issues a "red extreme heat warning" as temperatures are predicted to reach [[United Kingdom weather records|a record]] {{cvt|41|C|F}} in parts of [[England]]. [[Wales]] reports a record temperature of {{cvt|37.1|C|F}} near the town of [[Hawarden]], [[Flintshire]], and the island of [[Jersey]] reports a record temperature of {{cvt|37.9|C|F}}. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-62201793 (BBC News)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/uk-62184978 (BBC News 2)] [https://www.itv.com/news/channel/2022-07-18/temperatures-break-jerseys-all-time-record (ITV Channel Islands)]
***The [[Royal Air Force]] suspends all flights to and from [[RAF Brize Norton]] in [[Oxfordshire]] after the runway suffers damage due to the extreme heat. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/raf-runway-brize-norton-heatwave-b2125735.html (''The Independent'')]
**[[Dublin]], [[Ireland]], reports a record temperature of {{cvt|33.1|C|F}}. Parts of [[France]] also report record temperatures. [https://www.met.ie/temperature-records-broken-as-met-eireann-establish-new-climate-services-division (Met Éireann)] [https://www.leprogres.fr/environnement/2022/07/18/apocalypse-de-chaleur-ce-lundi-dans-une-france-rouge-canicule (''Le Progrès'')]
*[[Sadiqabad boat sinking]]
**Twenty people are killed and 30 others are missing after a boat capsizes in [[Sadiqabad, Punjab|Sadiqabad]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/18/several-killed-after-boat-capsizes-in-pakistan (Al Jazeera)]
*Thirty-one people are injured and several homes are destroyed after a magnitude 5.1 [[list of earthquakes in Afghanistan|earthquake]] hits [[Paktika Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. It is an aftershock of the [[June 2022 Afghanistan earthquake|June 22 quake]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-taliban-earthquakes-194ab2cda6f41a4c632ff654389c335f (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Shanghai]]
****Residents in nine of [[Shanghai]]'s districts will be required to undergo [[COVID-19 testing]] until July 21 as part of an effort to reduce the community spread of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/covid-19-china-shanghai-hold-mass-covid-testing-exercise-2817446 (CNA)]
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
***The [[Rhode Island Department of Health]] announces that [[Rhode Island|the state]] has administered [[Smallpox vaccine|monkeypox vaccines]] to people who have had close contact with [[monkeypox]] patients. [https://www.abc6.com/monkeypox-vaccines-administered-to-close-contacts-in-rhode-island/ (WLNE-TV)]
*Wild [[European bison]] are [[Rewilding (conservation biology)|reintroduced]] to the [[United Kingdom]] for the first time in over a thousand years after three are released into a [[pine|pine forest]] in [[Kent]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-kent-62164223 (BBC News]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Ecuador prison riots]]
**Thirteen [[inmate]]s are killed and two more injured during a [[prison riot]] in [[Santo Domingo, Ecuador|Santo Domingo]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://apnews.com/article/prisons-caribbean-ecuador-quito-98fb5e11f99a7d2c2a9a93bfcabc418f (AP)]
*Four people are injured during a [[mass shooting]] at a nightclub in [[Marbella]], [[Andalusia]], [[Spain]]. The perpetrator is stabbed and hospitalized. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-aa53d880cd06e3ece0b6b46136d035b3 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] dismisses [[Ukraine]]'s [[Prosecutor General of Ukraine|prosecutor general]] [[Iryna Venediktova]] and the [[Head of the Security Service of Ukraine|top security official]] of the [[Security Service of Ukraine]], [[Ivan Bakanov]]. More than 60 officials from the agencies are alleged to be working with [[Russia]]. Additionally, 651 cases of alleged treason and collaboration are initiated against prosecutorial and law enforcement officials. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jul/17/zelenskiy-fires-ukraines-spy-chief-and-top-state-prosecutor (''The Guardian'')] 
*[[July 2022 United Kingdom government crisis|2022 United Kingdom government crisis]]
**[[July 2022 Conservative Party leadership election|2022 Conservative Party leadership election]]
***[[Tom Tugendhat]] is eliminated from the leadership race in the third round of voting. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jul/18/tom-tugendhat-knocked-out-tory-leadership-race-final-four (''The Guardian'')]
**[[2022 vote of confidence in the Johnson ministry]]
***A motion of confidence in the [[Second Johnson ministry|Johnson government]] is passed by 347 votes to 238. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2022/jul/18/boris-johnson-defends-record-as-government-faces-confidence-vote (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2022 Indian presidential election]]
**The [[Parliament of India|Indian parliament]] votes to elect the new [[President of India]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/18/india-legislators-vote-for-president-tribal-woman-likely-to-win (Al Jazeera)]
